cmd.description: ⚙️ Configure your FFXIV character profile, main job, portraits, Tomestone, and FFLogs settings.

needPhoto: ⚠️ You cannot turn off the portrait unless a **Full Photo** has been added!
selectRoleHelp: Please choose your character role category from the dropdown below.
selectJobHelp: Choose your specific main job from the dropdown below.
invalidLodestone: ❌ Invalid Lodestone URL or ID format.
invalidImageUrl: ❌ That is not a valid image link. Please use a link starting with https://
dashHelp: Changes save automatically when you click buttons or submit modals.

claim.title: 🔐 Claim your character
claim.steps:
1. Copy this code:
```{code}```
2. Open your [Lodestone character page]({link}), edit your **character profile** text, paste the code anywhere in it and save.
3. Click **✅ Verify** below.

The code works once and expires {expires}. The Lodestone can take a few minutes to show changes. You can remove the code from your profile afterwards.
claim.verified: ✅ **{name}** is now claimed and set as your Main!
claim.verifiedMoved: ✅ **{name}** is now claimed and set as your Main! It was moved from another Discord account.
claim.madeMain: ⭐ This character is now your Main.
claim.limitFree: ❌ More than {free} characters need Supporter Perks (up to {max} with them). Turn them on in My Settings on pingway.app, or unclaim a character there first.
claim.limitMax: ❌ You can claim up to {max} characters. Unclaim one in My Settings on pingway.app first.

reason.badId: ❌ Invalid Lodestone URL or ID format.
reason.tooManyCodes: ❌ Too many claim codes today. Please try again tomorrow.
reason.noCode: ❌ No open claim code. Click **Link Lodestone** to get one.
reason.used: ❌ This claim code was already used. Click **Link Lodestone** to get a new one.
reason.expired: ❌ This claim code has expired. Click **Link Lodestone** to get a new one.
reason.wait: ⏳ Please wait {n} seconds before checking again.
reason.tooManyChecks: ❌ Too many checks for this code. Click **Link Lodestone** to get a new one.
reason.notfound: ❌ That Lodestone character was not found. Check the link.
reason.private: 🔒 Your Lodestone profile is private. Make it public, then click **✅ Verify** again.
reason.missing: 🔍 The code isn't in your Lodestone profile yet. Save it there, wait a minute and click **✅ Verify** again.
reason.wrong: 🔍 Your Lodestone profile has a different Pingway code. Paste the newest code and click **✅ Verify** again.
reason.error: ⚠️ Couldn't reach the Lodestone right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
